train_navigation_model: train a CNN or LSTM navigation model for embodied QA using the argparse CLI with -model_type and -train_h5 flags
evaluate_navigation_model: evaluate a trained navigation model on val or test splits using -mode eval and -eval_split flags
train_pacman_model: train a hierarchical planner-controller navigation model using -model_type pacman with separate planner and controller losses
run_curriculum_training: run curriculum learning for LSTM models using -curriculum 1 to gradually increase action sequence length during training
checkpoint_and_resume: save and resume training from a checkpoint using -checkpoint_path to load model state and optimizer state
